column1: # The same content as easy.tsv and tricky.tsv, cut at 文節 boundaries.
# This is the unit the product actually converts. Typing a whole sentence and
# pressing space once is what a connection matrix buys you, and this engine
# does not have one — measured, a scalar-only model does *worse* on whole
# sentences than on the same text converted phrase by phrase (22.4% vs 26.0%),
# while a bigram model does better (63.3% vs 60.0%). Tuning against the
# sentence sets was optimising a number this architecture cannot reach.
# Keeping both granularities on the same content makes the gap visible rather
